intent: Fix the `plumb`/`proofgate` bin so `npx github:amos-labs/plumbline` works. The bin pointed at dist/cli.js, which is never committed (.gitignore keeps only dist/index.js) and is produced only by the devDependency tsc via the prepare script. npx installs a git dependency without devDeps, so cli.js is never built and the bin silently resolves to nothing: `plumb receipt --write` exits 0 and does nothing, which reads as success and drives agents to hand-edit receipts. dist/index.js is the committed, self-contained esbuild bundle of src/cli.ts (the same entry the Action runs via `node dist/index.js run`) and carries a `#!/usr/bin/env node` shebang, so pointing the bin at it makes the CLI work over npx with zero build.

validation_plan.reason: Proves the published bin symlink resolves to an executable entry (the failure mode was a bin pointing at an uncommitted, unbuilt file).
Proves the committed bundle is a working CLI that executes the receipt subcommands the bin must serve.
Confirms no regression in the shape/review logic from the packaging change.

execution_evidence.output_ref: With the fixed bin, ./node_modules/.bin/plumb resolved to dist/index.js and executed (RC 0). Before the fix the bin pointed at a missing dist/cli.js and silently no-op'd.

execution_evidence.command: node dist/index.js receipt --check --receipt .plumbline/receipts/*.json (in a consumer repo)
execution_evidence.output_ref: Printed '✓ mechanical fields are fresh (diff_sha256 matches the committed diff)' and generated this very receipt via `node dist/index.js receipt --write` — the bundle is a fully working CLI.

execution_evidence.skip_reason: Corroborated by the plumbline CI test job on the pushed head; this is a package.json bin/packaging change with no change to src logic.

result_summary: One-line packaging fix: bin plumb/proofgate now point at the committed self-contained dist/index.js bundle instead of the never-committed dist/cli.js, so `npx github:amos-labs/plumbline#master receipt --write` works with zero build (previously exited 0 and did nothing, which is why agents fell back to hand-editing receipts). Verified first-hand: the installed bin resolves and executes (RC 0), and the bundle runs the receipt subcommands (it generated this receipt). Unit tests delegated to plumbline CI. No src/logic change; package.json is not a protected path.
